config.fitAPI: One warm-start fit per minibatch; max_iter=1; no optimizer state because momentum=0
config.initialization: scikit-learn default; random_state varies only the initial weights and biases
config.sampling: Identical external permutation each epoch for all widths and initializations; shuffle=False inside MLPRegressor
config.stopRule: Exactly the stated number of epochs and minibatch updates; no validation or tolerance-based early stopping; convergence is not asserted
config.objective: Half mean squared error; no regularization
config.metric: Mean squared error on all 2,048 training observations
config.gridMetric: Mean squared error on 4,000 evenly spaced midpoints of [-1,1]
config.plotGrid: 401 evenly spaced points on [-1,1], including endpoints
